project.name: melanablac
project.productType: Independent art and illustrated greeting card storefront

decisions: Retain the white editorial design; use the established black and gold brand palette from melanablac.com.
Use original artwork and existing films; no stock replacements.
Keep the real catalogue, category filters, basket, checkout, contact and administration.
Remove external marketplace links and editable marketplace settings.
Muted films without visible playback buttons; honour reduced motion.
Preserve the original signature logo using public/logo-dark.png on ivory, in both header and footer.
On mobile, show the complete hero film with contain sizing and overlay its heading; keep description and button below. Retain the full text overlay on desktop.
Product cards and collection boxes use black backgrounds with gold borders and readable light text, retaining white page backgrounds.
Enquiries open with an uncropped gallery film and overlaid heading, followed by a short introduction beside the white form, stacked on mobile.
Artwork editor uses plain-language sections and one customer description; optional Google search overrides and display order are collapsed with automatic fallback guidance.

evidence.fact: Brand colours: gold #D4AF37, secondary gold #C9AB47, black #121212 and white.
evidence.source: https://melanablac.com (computed styles inspected with Ego Lite)
